caption: The drawing depicts a round, iron grate with vertical bars, shown from an angled, slightly elevated perspective. The grate has three short legs at the bottom, supporting it above the surface, and a long, flat handle extending from one side, with a hole near the end of the handle. The bars of the grate are evenly spaced, and the handle is attached with a visible joint, which is represented as a hexagonal bolt at the center where the handle meets the grate. The entire object is rendered in a dark gray tone, with shading to indicate the iron material, set against a plain, light-colored background. The drawing is executed in a realistic manner, showing detailed texture and form. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature with the text "S. Borriazza."
title: Gridiron
